about_short_description.short_description: Per Vices, an SDR platform, enables software developers to write applications to interact with all types of wireless signals and devices.

product.name: Cyan
product.description: A software defined radio platform with up to 16 independent transmit or receive channels, tuning from near DC to 18 GHz, supporting up to 1 GHz RF bandwidth per channel and digital throughput up to 400 Gbps.

product.name: Crimson TNG
product.description: A flexible SDR platform with 4 receive and 4 transmit channels, tuning from near DC to 6 GHz, supporting up to 325 MHz bandwidth per channel and 20 Gbps digital throughput.

product.name: Chestnut
product.description: An SDR platform with 4 receive and 4 transmit channels, tuning from near DC to 9 GHz, supporting up to 500 MHz bandwidth per channel and 160 Gbps digital throughput.

product.name: Calamine
product.description: A software defined radio receiver with 4 independent receive channels, tuning from near DC to 40 GHz, supporting up to 300 MHz bandwidth per channel and 20 Gbps digital throughput.

product.name: Host & Storage Solutions
product.description: Custom-built host systems for processing, storage, and recording of data from SDR platforms, pre-configured for immediate use and extendable to meet evolving project needs.
